description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_Token_End class, representing an end token in the HTML Purifier library, which extends a tag token class, and includes methods for token handling.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Token_End
classes.description: A class representing an end token in the HTMLPurifier tokenization process, extending HTMLPurifier_Token_Tag, with a reference to the starting token and a method to convert to node (not supported).

methods.name: toNode
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating that converting this token to a node is not supported.
